hooks.command:
sh -c 'GRAPH=".beads/graph/metadata.json"; LOCK=".beads/graph/.gemini_reminded"; if [ -f "$GRAPH" ] && [ ! -f "$LOCK" ]; then touch "$LOCK" && cat <<HOOKEOF
{"decision":"allow","additionalContext":"[para-graph] Knowledge graph is available for this project. Prioritize using mcp_para-graph_graph_query or mcp_para-graph_graph_context_bundle to understand architecture before reading raw files."}
HOOKEOF
else echo "{\"decision\":\"allow\"}"; fi'
